subject: [PATCH 25/60] mm/mempolicy: queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a patch to queue only common memory folios for mbind() and migrate_pages().

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the memory policy (mempolicy) in the Linux kernel by optimizing the queueing of folios for migration and binding. The focus is on common memory, which includes ZONE_DEVICE folios that do not count as failures when using MPOL_MF_STRICT. The changes involve converting checks from `folio_is_zone_device` to `folio_is_common_memory`. This approach ensures that only common memory folios are queued, reducing unnecessary work and improving performance.
